# Mohamed Barkat — Performance Marketer for D2C & Shopify Brands

> Performance marketer for D2C and Shopify brands that want to scale ad spend profitably while keeping CAC under control. Fixes tracking and creative together across Meta, Google and TikTok. 5+ years in paid acquisition, including a multi-country super app. Based in Ho Chi Minh City, working remotely. Subscription apps are served through Appfound (https://appfound.vercel.app/).

## The offer
- Profitable Scale: one monthly engagement. Tracking fixed and checked against Shopify or the backend, a researched creative testing plan, campaigns restructured so the budget follows profitable purchases, and a weekly report with the next move. Spend is raised only while cost per new customer stays under an agreed ceiling.
- Price is set on a free 30-minute call, after looking at the store's numbers.

## Selected results (client names withheld)
- High-ticket wellness equipment (D2C): 9.96x platform-attributed ROAS on Meta Advantage+, $114,150 purchase value from $11,462 spend.
- Watch accessories (D2C, Australia): 1,260 purchases at $18.27 from the top Meta campaign; $113,630 spend across 36 campaigns.
- Consumer electronics e-commerce: 28,881 website purchases at €1.41 (Meta, platform-attributed).
- Beauty Shopify store: 19,049 orders in 12 months, +32% vs prior year (Shopify, all channels).
- Super app, North Africa: 116,464 first deliveries in 2025 at $1.81 each on $211K acquisition spend.
